data.description: The gold standard. Known for the best dynamic range in the industry and 'filmic' color science that looks exactly like real life.
data.promptModifiers: arri alexa 35 format, high dynamic range, cinematic filmic color science, ultra realistic

data.description: The full-frame king. Famous for its natural skin tones and its ability to shoot in incredibly low light without noise.
data.promptModifiers: sony venice 2, full frame sensor, natural skin tones, noise-free low light, cinematic lighting

data.description: The speed demon. Offers 8K resolution and extremely high frame rates, perfect for crisp, high-detail action and slow motion.
data.promptModifiers: red v-raptor xl 8k, crisp hyper-detailed, high frame rate, extreme sharpness, action cinematography

data.description: A rental-only hybrid. Combines RED's 8K sensor with Panavision's legendary color science and large-format optics.
data.promptModifiers: panavision millennium dxl2, large-format optics, panavision color science, 8k cinematic

data.description: The definitive 35mm film cameras. They provide that organic grain and mechanical soul that digital still tries to replicate.
data.promptModifiers: arricam 35mm film, organic film grain, analog texture, cinematic 35mm stock, rich halation

data.description: The prestige 35mm choice. Used by directors like Christopher Nolan for its rock-solid reliability and classic Hollywood feel.
data.promptModifiers: panavision millennium xl2, 35mm film prestige, classic hollywood blockbuster look, rich depth

data.description: The elite Super 16mm camera. Delivers a gritty, nostalgic texture used in modern masterpieces like Carol or The Bear.
data.promptModifiers: arriflex 416 super 16mm, gritty nostalgic film texture, heavy analog grain, cinematic rough look
